macro.build.label: Build constraint engine
macro.conflictLayers.externalPlaceholder: How external systems, threats, or the environment keep pressuring the protagonist.
macro.conflictLayers.internalPlaceholder: How the protagonist's inner fears, desires, or misjudgments turn against them.
macro.conflictLayers.relationalPlacehold: How key relationships create the cost of choices and emotional tension.
macro.conflictLayers.title: Conflict layers
macro.constraintEngine.desc: What's saved here is the rule source that later character, main-line, and chapter planning can consume directly.
macro.constraintEngine.empty: No constraint engine yet. Finish decomposing the story engine first, then click "Build constraint engine".
macro.constraintEngine.title: Constraint engine
macro.disclosure.desc: These are the finer story-engine editing and diagnostic details. Collapsed by default so newcomers aren't overwhelmed by fields before they've set a direction.
macro.disclosure.title: Story engine and advanced constraints
macro.engine.desc: This defines why the story can keep going: how the protagonist is trapped, how conflict escalates, and how the unknown keeps readers reading.
macro.engine.title: Story engine prototype
macro.hardConstraints.desc: These rules act as hard boundaries for later generation, keeping the story from drifting downstream.
macro.hardConstraints.title: Hard constraints
macro.hero.desc: This step comes before character creation. It does not generate a specific cast; instead it first rebuilds the story into a story-engine prototype that can keep advancing.
macro.hero.title: Story macro planning
macro.issues.title: Conflicts and information gaps
macro.narrativeRules.label: Narrative rules
macro.narrativeRules.placeholder: One mandatory narrative rule per line.
macro.payoffs.label: Key payoffs
macro.setpiece.placeholder: One high-tension set piece per line.
macro.setpiece.title: High-tension set-piece seeds
macro.state.desc: Save the current phase and the protagonist's situation for reuse as later chapters advance.
macro.state.protagonistPlaceholder: For example: still in denial about the truth, but can no longer back out.
macro.state.title: Story state
macro.storyInput.label: Story idea input
macro.storyInput.placeholder: Describe the story idea, the pressure you want, the styles to avoid, and the ending you lean toward, in natural language.
macro.summary.desc: This is a compressed summary of the story engine, consumed directly by later outlining, beats, and writing.
macro.summary.title: Progression and payoff summary
macro.takeover.desc: AI first checks whether the Story Macro / Book Contract already exists, then decides whether to fill in the missing pieces or rerun the current step as you choose.
macro.takeover.title: Take over from story macro planning
macroField.conflict_engine.label: Conflict engine
macroField.conflict_engine.placeholder: Explain clearly why the story can keep escalating, rather than writing just one conflict.
macroField.core_conflict.label: Long-term opposition
macroField.emotional_line.label: Emotional progression
macroField.emotional_line.placeholder: Describe how emotion deepens layer by layer, not just intensifies.
macroField.ending_flavor.label: Ending flavor
macroField.ending_flavor.placeholder: For example: collapse, open-endedness, reversal, or calm restraint.
macroField.expanded_premise.label: Reinforced premise
macroField.expanded_premise.placeholder: Write the reinforced story premise first, so the pressure and suspense hold up.
macroField.growth_path.label: Growth path
macroField.growth_path.placeholder: Describe how the protagonist's understanding shifts in stages.
macroField.main_hook.label: Main hook
macroField.main_hook.placeholder: Write the main-line question that carries an unknown.
macroField.mystery_box.label: Core unknown
macroField.mystery_box.placeholder: Write the question readers most want answered but cannot resolve yet.
macroField.progression_loop.label: Progression loop
macroField.progression_loop.placeholder: Spell out how discovery -> escalation -> reversal loops.
macroField.protagonist_core.label: Protagonist's core situation
macroField.protagonist_core.placeholder: Describe how the protagonist is trapped, the cracks, and the room for change.
macroField.selling_point.label: One-line selling point
macroField.selling_point.placeholder: Explain in one sentence what most attracts readers to this work.
macroField.tone_reference.label: Narrative tone
macroField.tone_reference.placeholder: Writing style, narrative stance, and method of control.
payoff.arrangeEmpty: This volume's chapters have no payoff links filled in yet, making it harder to check which setups to resolve during later breakdown.
payoff.arrangeHint: This shows the payoff links already attached to chapters in this volume, to check whether the breakdown truly reached chapter-level execution.
payoff.itemUnlinked: This open payoff isn't yet linked to a specific chapter in this volume; add a payoff link during chapter breakdown.
payoff.openEmpty: No open payoffs have been filled in for this volume yet.
payoff.openHint: These are the open payoffs declared in the volume strategy, showing which setups to plant and which threads to resolve in this volume.
payoff.subtitle: This looks only at the currently selected volume, to check whether the volume's open payoffs match the chapter payoff arrangements. The book-wide canonical ledger has moved to its own module above.
payoff.title: Current volume foreshadowing / payoff reference
versionHistory.desc: This helps you recover the most recent stable version first. Before restoring, the system automatically backs up the current state again.
versionHistory.empty: No version records yet. Consider manually saving a version before major direction changes, batch generation, or large rewrites.
versionHistory.restoreConfirm: The current state is automatically backed up before restoring. Restore this version?
versionHistory.snapshotDesc: This version is useful when you want to roll back to a more stable chapter-progress state.
versionHistory.title: Version history
workspace.exec.collapsedHint: Chapter planning currently centers on "pick a chapter + refine". Batch task-sheet filling, link diff, and JSON preview are collapsed by default to avoid interrupting the main flow.

workspace.exec.title: Chapter execution links

workspace.guidance.focusedNoChapter: Focused on "{{label}}", showing {{visible}} chapters; next, select a chapter to refine on the left.
workspace.guidance.locked: Generate a beat sheet for the current volume first, so the system can align the volume's progression beats with its chapter breakdown.
workspace.header.subtitle: Pick a volume, review the beats, then choose the chapter to refine from the matching chapters.
